title: The great tree cut down (Nebuchadnezzar's second dream)

symbols.description: Reaches the sky, visible to the ends of the earth; shelter and food for all
A heavenly figure who decrees the felling
symbols.in_text_interpretation: The decree of the watchers / the Most High (4:17, 24).

symbols.symbol: Stump bound with iron and bronze
symbols.in_text_interpretation: The kingdom will be restored after he acknowledges Heaven's rule (4:26).

symbols.description: Period passing over the one with an animal's heart
symbols.in_text_interpretation: The king's period of exclusion until he knows that the Most High rules (4:25, 32).

description: A tree at the centre of the earth reaching to the sky, sheltering beasts and birds, is ordered cut down by a holy watcher; the stump is left bound with iron and bronze, and "seven times" pass over him.
